notes.title: Playtest Final Patch Notes - 6/30/24
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
-Players are no longer downed in one hit by enemies
(there is now a 3 hit system, 1st will wound you, 2nd will down you, 3rd will be fatal)
(healing resets this and you can take all 3 hits again)

-AI now become stunned for a brief moment after damaging a player
(giving the player a chance to get away wounded

-Adjustments to AI Pathfinding and Hunting/Aggression States
(they shouldn't be as campy anymore when trying to find their target)

-Added new Environment

-Removed The Forsaken from having a chance to spawn at the Metro

[b]Fixes:[/b]
-Fixed not being able to hear alive players when dead
-Fixed more objects from being climbable
-Fixed players being able to jump onto the train tracks
-Fixed diving board from breaking ai navigation
-Fixed fire escape stairs

notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes - 6/29/24
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
- Time is a bit faster
- Added a train door lever on the outside
- Added a toggle for the camera breathing effect in gameplay options
- Added a secret in one of the cells 🤫 

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed standing on top of objects (desks, minifridge, chairs, etc...)
- Fixed train door bugs
- Fixed Data-Deck Sliders (for real this time)
- Radio volume now uses the music volume
- Fixed bug allowing players to revisit the pentagon again when loading a saved run
- Players should no longer be randomly killed sometimes when respawning
- Fixed several network RPC bugs related to items/equipment causing a late-joiner to crash/black screen while connecting to the lobby

notes.title: June Playtest Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Playtest Patch Notes - 6/28/24[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay changes:[/h3]
-Metro is brighter (Lights are more likely to spawn)
-Equipment is cheaper (Up to 75%)
-Travel cost is cheaper (Up to 60%)
-Loot value has been increased (2x)
-Can toggle train door to keep enemies out of the train
-Added a cosmetic poster

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
-Fixed the dreaded stair killer bug
-Fixed bug where players drop over dead after respawning on the train
-Fixed couch collider on Hotel
-When loading a save game, the saved max player size should be loaded now
-Lobby privacy is now saved (planning to add an option in the future to let you change the privacy of a saved game)
-Fixed audio from changing on it's own
